description: Performs a structured firewall rule base audit against CIS Controls v8 (Controls 4.4 and 4.5) and NIST SP 800-41 Rev 1 (Guidelines on Firewalls and Firewall Policy). Auto-invoked when reviewing firewall configurations, ACLs, or network security policies. Produces a prioritized findings report covering overly permissive rules, shadowed rules, logging gaps, and egress filtering deficiencies.
